summary: A Quote subscription: a detailed packet with no trade time (0) gives a Quote frame without ltt.

notes: A trade time of 0 is no trade yet: the desktop's frame has no ltt (never the receipt time); the web's frames have none at all since a1d539764.

deviations.reason: The detailed packet carries the book's totals (total_buy_quantity and total_sell_quantity, packet_decoder.py _DETAILED at bytes 38 and 46); the web's Quote frame leaves them out (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_detailed_data; its Depth frame names the snapquote's as totalbuyqty and totalsellqty): market data the broker sent, lost. The desktop's Quote frame keeps them.
